s.note: ham and cheese out of the little glass doors
s.how: Mash 40g soft butter with 1 tsp Dijon mustard and spread over 8 slices white bread. Fill with 200g leg ham and 4 slices Swiss cheese. Cut off the crusts, cut into quarters and wrap in wax paper, like the automat windows.
Warm 8 cake doughnuts at 160C for 4 minutes and shake them in a bag with 80g caster sugar and 2 tsp cinnamon while hot. Brew 1L drip coffee from 60g ground coffee and serve in diner mugs.

m.how: Butterfly 600g green prawns, leaving the tails on. Dust in 50g flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs, then press into 80g panko mixed with 80g shredded coconut. Fry at 180C for 2 minutes until golden. Serve with 150ml sweet chilli sauce and lime wedges.

w.how: Boil 2 whole oranges for 1 hour until soft, cool and blitz smooth, skin and all. Beat 6 eggs with 250g caster sugar, then mix in the oranges, 250g almond meal and 1 tsp baking powder. Pour into a lined 22cm tin and bake at 180C for 1 hour. Cool in the tin.

d.note: the diner where Joe counts his last coins
d.how: Brew 1 litre of drip coffee with 50g ground coffee. Pour into four thick mugs with a splash of milk, about 150ml in total, and two sugars in each.
